_note: Region data for area-type items of 24S-A. RAW_SCHEMA has no `region` field, so it lives here. Ids are built question ids. X,Y independent U(0,1) (unit square).

24S-A-Q1b.distribution: uniform on the unit square (X, Y independent U(0,1)); L = sqrt(x^2 + y^2)
24S-A-Q1b.eventBoundary: circle x^2 + y^2 = 1 and circle x^2 + y^2 = 1/4

24S-A-Q1c.distribution: uniform on the unit square (X, Y independent U(0,1)); L = sqrt(1 + (x - y)^2)
24S-A-Q1c.eventBoundary: lines y = x + 1/3 and y = x - 1/3
